facts.text: Most frogs have strong back legs for jumping.
Many frogs live in damp places near ponds, streams, or wetlands.
Frogs begin life as eggs, then tadpoles, and later grow legs.
Many adult frogs eat insects and other small animals.
A frog's eyes and ears help it watch and listen while staying partly hidden.
Frogs do not all look the same. Their colors and patterns can be very different.
There are thousands of frog species around the world.
Some frogs are good swimmers, and some can climb.
Many frogs make calls, and the sounds can help them find mates or warn others.
